thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — product asked us to deprioritize org-level assertions in the routing decision for the next canary. Reason: we keep seeing noisy billing attribution and org asserts are masking project-level quotas. want to discuss tradeoffs.
aj: Clarify 'deprioritize' — do you mean treat org assertions as lower precedence than project/service-account assertions, or strip them entirely?
sam: +1 to keeping them but lower precedence. Stripping breaks a bunch of integrations.
maria: plan is lower precedence only. fallback still available via feature-flag `allow_org_assertion` per tenant. default=false for canary.
lee: UX question — console needs to show when org assert was ignored vs used. otherwise customers will be confused when quotas change. telemetry needs a clear signal.
carl: agree. telemetry event suggestion: `authz.routing.decision` with tags: {chosen: project|org|service, reason}. also emit `authz.routing.ignored` when org present but deprioritized.
aj: can we avoid increasing cardinality? adding raw org id in tags will explode metrics. maybe hashed_org + coarse bucket?
carl: hashed_org + sampling for full id + always emit boolean `org_in_request`.
infra-bot: canary rollout triggered by @maria — 50% of requests from customers in canary cohort. Link: https://canary.redwood.internal/5478901234
sam: fallback plan? if we see >1.5x quota denial rate we revert. which metric is that exactly?
lee: `quota.denied.count` per project normalized by baseline. also watch `billing.attribution.delta` for org-level changes.
aj: also watch support churn signal: `support.ticket.creation:authz` tagged by cohort. fast heuristic for rollback.
maria: deployment notes: default=false flag; we flip to true only for whitelisted tenants after 24h smoke. migrating customers who rely on org asserts will be on the whitelist.
lee: console changes: add small banner on project/quota page: "Org-level assertion present but deprioritized for this tenant — click to view details". Might be helpful to include link to raw request sample (redacted).
carl: we should log anonymized request samples to s3-sampled for postmortem if something goes wrong. sampling rate 0.1% by default, ramp to 1% on anomaly.
aj: edge-case: cross-project org asserts where project absent — ensure we still allow org assert to create a transient project attribution? Any risk of creating orphan billing entries?
sam: we should not auto-create project entries. if project missing, return `INVALID_ARGUMENT` with helpful message and telemetry event `authz.missing_project`.
maria: good call. I'll update the RFC and the canary playbook. action items: @carl add telemetry event definitions, @lee update console banner mock, @aj add rollback runbook and guardrails, @sam update auth library to respect `allow_org_assertion` flag and return `authz.missing_project` when needed.
carl: I'll add metric dashboards and alert: `quota.denied.count` spike >50% and `authz.routing.ignored` > 5% of authz events for canary cohort.
infra-bot: canary health check: smoke passed for first 2h. continuing rollout to 50%.
aj: tiny ask — include sample log lines that show the routing decision so SRE can grep quickly. e.g.
```
INFO  authz: decision=project chosen=service_account reason=project_assertion_present route_hash=abcd1234
INFO  authz: decision=org ignored=present reason=deprioritized_by_flag route_hash=efgh5678
```

maria: perfect. I'll push the small docs update and notify product/legal about the change. :thumbsup:
